sentences.text: Linkin Park is an American rock band from Agoura Hills , California .	rock	Rock music

Formed in 1996 , the band rose to international fame with their debut album Hybrid Theory -LRB- 2000 -RRB- , which was certified diamond by the RIAA in 2005 and multi-platinum in several other countries .	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory	diamond	Oro album	RIAA	Recording Industry Association of America	multi-platinum	Music recording sales certification

Their following studio album Meteora continued the band 's success , topping the Billboard 200 album chart in 2003 , and was followed by extensive touring and charity work around the world .	Meteora	Meteora (album)
In 2003 , MTV2 named Linkin Park the sixth-greatest band of the music video era and the third-best of the new millennium .	MTV2	MTV2
Billboard ranked Linkin Park No. 19 on the Best Artists of the Decade chart .
In 2012 , the band was voted as the greatest artist of the 2000s in a Bracket Madness poll on VH1 .
In 2014 , the band was declared as the Biggest Rock Band in the World Right Now by Kerrang !

Having adapted nu metal and rap metal to a radio-friendly yet densely layered style in Hybrid Theory and Meteora , the band explored other genres in their next studio album , Minutes to Midnight -LRB- 2007 -RRB- .	nu metal	nu metal	Hybrid Theory	Hybrid Theory	Meteora	Meteora (album)	rap metal	rap metal	Minutes to Midnight	Minutes to Midnight (album)
The album topped the Billboard charts and had the third-best debut week of any album that year .

The band continued to explore a wider variation of musical types in their fourth album , A Thousand Suns -LRB- 2010 -RRB- , layering their music with more electronic sounds and beats .	A Thousand Suns	A Thousand Suns	electronic	Electronic music
Their fifth album , Living Things -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , combines musical elements from all of their previous records .	Living Things	Living Things (Linkin Park album)
Their sixth album , The Hunting Party -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , returned to a heavier rock sound .	rock	Rock music	The Hunting Party	The Hunting Party (album)
Their seventh album One More Light , a more electronic and pop-oriented record , was released on May 19 , 2017 .	electronic	Electronic music	One More Light	One More Light

The band has collaborated with several other artists , including rapper Jay Z in their mashup EP Collision Course , and many others on the remix albums Reanimation and Recharged .
